description: Draw 1 to 4 images from a prompt. Without `profile` the prompt reaches the image model exactly as written, for anything, not only Instagram. With `profile` the image is drawn in that profile's look (its visual style and colours). Each newly generated image costs one credit from the Espaço's monthly quota; one that fails is not charged. Answers with a download link per image, valid for 7 days. Save the file if you need it longer. Pass a `requestId` so a retry after a timeout returns these images instead of drawing new ones.

profile.description: A profile's handle from list_profiles, or its permanent UUID

requestId.description: Any id you make up for this call, like a UUID. Send the same one if you retry after a timeout or a lost answer: you get the first answer back and nothing is spent twice. Remembered for 24 hours

name: generate_image
title: Generate an image
